name: IRIEBOT7.io Autonomous Trading Dashboard
tag: Watch AI agents run technical and fundamental analysis on your watchlist in one dashboard.

scenarios.title: Analyze a watchlist
scenarios.ask: Analyze my {tickers} stocks on the {timeframe} chart, weighting technicals at {tech}.
steps: Technical agent
Read trend, momentum and volume on the {timeframe} chart for all {tickers} sample stocks.
Fundamental agent
Scored revenue growth, margins, debt and valuation from sample filings.
Blender
Combined scores at {tech} technical and {=100 - tech}% fundamental.
Conflict checker
Found {=max(1, round(tickers * 0.16))} stocks where chart and fundamentals disagree and marked them for review.
Dashboard
Ranked the list and added a short note on each stock explaining its score.
followups: What does a conflicting signal mean?

The chart says one thing and the business data says another, for example a strong uptrend on a company with falling margins. Those {=max(1, round(tickers * 0.16))} stocks are worth a closer human look.
The dashboard shows analysis and agent reasoning. Any trading connection is optional, and the analysis is not a recommendation to buy or sell.

scenarios.title: Check a stock before earnings
scenarios.ask: {name_hint} reports in {days} days. Run both analyses and show the key risks.
steps: Fundamental agent
Compared the last 4 quarters of sample results with the trend in guidance.
Technical agent
Marked support and resistance levels about {move} away from the current price.
News agent
Summarized {=3 + name_hint * 2} sample headlines from the last {days} days.
Risk note
Wrote what could move the stock and how far it has moved after past reports.

result.title: Pre-earnings brief
rows: Past moves don't predict the next one

followups: Can I get an alert when earnings are out?
Yes. The dashboard reruns both agents within minutes of the report and highlights what changed.
They give a sense of how much the price has swung after reports, about {move} here. It is context, not a forecast.

scenarios.title: Get a morning market brief
scenarios.ask: Give me a {minutes}-minute morning brief across {sectors} sectors.
steps: Macro agent
Summarized overnight sample moves in rates, currencies and futures.
Sector agent
Ranked {sectors} sectors by sample momentum and breadth.
Watchlist agent
Pulled {=sectors * 2} watchlist names with new signals since yesterday.
Writer
Kept it to about {=minutes * 140} words so it reads in {minutes}.
followups: Can it focus only on my holdings?
Yes. Switch the brief to holdings-only and the agents skip sectors you don't own.
On a schedule you set, for example 30 minutes before the open.
